houseStyle: 暖乳白、哑光剪纸、松绿与橘杏、儿童科学图册；物件轮廓和空间关系清楚。不生成文字、商标、交互控件。
pairReview: 同组必须是同一件收纳用品、同一个摆放状态。俯视读分隔或摆放位置，侧视读竖放、箱盖与高度；不能从图宣称取用更快。透明盖看得到原物，三组俯侧轮廓在小预览可辨。所有图需逐图两处资料核验后登记。

assets.description: Strict overhead close view into an upright open teal three-pocket backpack. A thin orange album lies flat on the broad bottom of the main cavity; a small apricot tape roll and flat violet eraser sit in a separated forward inner zipped section. The little gold-capped pale blue bottle is upright in an outside side mesh pocket. Exactly the backpack in row 2 column 1.

Strict overhead of a pale yellow rectangular storage box with a fully seated clear transparent lid. Through it show a small ochre inner tray and a blue small box, side by side, each holding a few foam toy pieces. Dark teal hinge marks and corners, no shiny reflection blocking contents. Same assembled box as row 2 column 2.

Strict overhead of a low coral desktop tray with visible straight partition between its long compartment (teal ruler without markings) and short compartment (cream and blue block). Same tray as row 2 column 3.

True low side elevation of exactly the same open upright teal backpack in row 1 col 1. Its capped pale blue bottle visibly stands upright in the front-facing side mesh, half surrounded by mesh. Keep bag, opening and bottle unchanged and show base resting flat.

True low side elevation of exactly the pale yellow toy storage box in row 1 col 2. Low transparency through same clear lid, closed and visibly straight against both lip edges. Same hinge marks. No extra contents, stacked objects, or opened angle.

True low side elevation of the same coral tray in row 1 col 3. Its flat edge and inset teal ruler plus cream and blue blocks below the rim are visibly distinct; use a transparent low front window to see depth without pretending the divider moved.
Simple isolated dark pine paper-cut camera, one golden lens, no lettering and no icons near it.
Quiet matte muted cream green activity tabletop background with subtle warm paper grain, no other objects or outlines that resemble the camera guides.
Single wide orange art album partly open with thick ivory pages, plain cover and no letters. Bold clean silhouette with broad pages.
Single small squat violet eraser with pale lavender edge, solid rectangular silhouette. No paper or sleeve text.
Single capped pale blue upright water bottle with golden screw top; keep identical color to bag-view pair.
Single clearly round orange ribbon roll with large central hole, almost face-on; no loose multiple pieces.
Single cream folded map with two angular folded panels, a soft teal path, no characters, dots or markers.
Wide open deep teal main bookbag pocket in close cutaway, broad horizontal opening, visible long orange book resting flat at base as structure clue.
Shallow teal front zipper pouch in close-up, unmistakable long yellow pull tab across small horizontal pocket, visible small orange tape inside.
Tall tapered side mesh pocket with teal seam, view of gold-capped pale blue bottle shape upright, crosshatch clearly apparent.
Top-down apricot campus supply cart with green handle and visibly empty basket. Isolated on exact plain removable cream, centered with full silhouette.
Same top-down small apricot cart, teal cloth bundle as visible pickup-state shape, identical wheelbase and crop. Exact plain removable cream.
Flat side-facing silhouette of a small olive campus delivery wagon with two wide wheels. Exact plain removable cream. Distinct from player cart.
Wide calm warm forest-green workroom road backdrop with no grid, no carts, no labels and quiet edges. Canvas gameplay elements will be added by code.

Original overhead view of the same pale green worktable in next cell. Four object groups: broad orange art album, teal ruler, same round orange ribbon roll partly blocked by the album, and cream and blue wood blocks loose. Empty shallow divided tray at right.

Same overhead pale green worktable, same orange album now flat to one side, same teal ruler and cream and blue blocks separated into long and short spaces in the same tray, orange ribbon roll visible and reachable. Exact same object groups and table.
Simple beige cloth tote open broadly from above front, soft colorful clean lightweight fabric props visible together in one cavity, small loop handles. Original quiet workroom.
Three-quarter front view of same teal backpack used in photo set, spread open to distinguish wide main cavity, front zipped pouch, side mesh pocket. Show only same object set, no words or diagrams.

Original kindergarten arts corner with soft low apron hook, divided tray for long teal ruler and chunky blocks, plus little lidded block container sitting in bigger chest. Three obvious separate objects in a simple wide workspace.
Same unfamiliar seafoam book bag as next two cells; match scale. Close-up of narrow low front zip opening with large rigid blank lilac art board beside it visibly too wide for the opening.

Same unfamiliar seafoam book bag in adjacent cells and same rigid blank lilac art board. Close-up of the broad main compartment visibly wide enough for the board to lie flat inside; full bag depth and board shown.
Same seafoam book bag in adjacent cells and same rigid blank lilac art board held next to its narrow outer bottle mesh opening. Visually too wide for side mesh, no writing.
Same small purple chunky square stamp as in next two cells and same open clay-colored utility pouch. Hand poised to take stamp exposed in a shallow open pocket; no visible word on stamp.
Same purple square stamp, deep pocket of same clay pouch. Show via unobtrusive cutaway that a large yellow cloth partly covers the stamp deep at the bottom; no hand retrieving it.
Same purple square stamp visibly pinned beneath a flat stack of two blank workbooks. No movement, no loose duplicate stamps, no books with letters.

Original small desk corner with three simple chronological picture panels, one recurring set of safe chunky objects. First hand sketches their initial locations on blank paper, then adult and child hands put them into separated places, then child hand reaches for one. Leave drawings blank of names and addresses.

Overhead original two-compartment teal tray, long cream-handled paintbrush and two chunky violet crayons visibly together in its long bay, short bay empty. Match same objects and tray in two next cells.

Same original teal tray and exact objects. Brush mostly covered by two adjacent thick violet crayons, a short cream end remains visible. Use depth and shadow to read that they overlap; short bay empty.
Same original teal tray and exact objects. Long cream-handled paintbrush by itself in long bay; both violet crayons clearly in separate short bay.
Top three-quarter view of child hand visibly lifting the only cobalt-blue crayon from a pale ochre desktop box, other colors stay inside. Same box and surroundings as adjacent two cells.
Same ochre desktop crayon box from adjacent cells, child hand closes its fully opaque lid. No blue crayon visible outside. Other same empty small bins nearby.
Same desktop. Child finger points toward the first of several small closed boxes; subtle separated placement, no written numerals, same ochre box present and no crayon is removed.

pocket-guide.layout: 三等宽图，左大袋、中前拉链袋、右侧网袋，居中并对齐讲解焦点，留足图边。

pocket-delivery-cover.layout: 绘板左下放小车和画册，右上放大袋，四周无文字，后期保留显眼起点和目标。

storage-badge.layout: 用橘色画册图标做圆角干净徽章，四周空白。

storage-photo-cover.layout: 同一只书包的正上与正侧并列，中间小相机。

storage-record-example.layout: 三列对应书包、箱、托盘；上排俯视，下排侧视，按列归对。仅为观察示例，不导出为孩子结果。
